Rules.Station: Station is split into DeviceID and DeviceName; it is the root node.
Rules.Device: DeviceID is Station DeviceID plus source DeviceID; CurrentLocationDeviceID is the station DeviceID.
Rules.Part: DeviceID is PartNumber plus an underscore and a per-PartNumber four-digit sequence.
Rules.Hierarchy: L1 is under Device, L2 is under L1, and L3 is under L2.
